name: Newtown Community Center Summer Day Camp
description_short: Full day camp at the Newtown Community Center and the Fairfield Hills campus for children entering kindergarten to grade 6. Each week has a theme, with sports, crafts, nature walks, pool time and a weekly visit to Newtown Youth Academy for turf and court games.
refund_policy_summary: Withdrawing from a full week earns a credit for future use; a full refund needs a doctor's note. No refunds or credits for single missed days. A $100 deposit per week is not refundable.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim test on the first day; non swimmers wear a life vest. No formal swim lessons. Indoor pool at the community center.
notes: Member rate $235 a week. Before care 7:30 to 9:00 am and after care 4:00 to 6:00 pm (the catalog gives $25 a week on one page and $50 on another). Half day specialty camps (art, nature, cooking) and toddler camps for ages 3 to 4 are also offered. Register through Community Pass.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Summer Camp Catalog (the town's flipbook; newtown-ct.gov refused our fetcher). Summer Bash full day camp, Monday to Friday 9:00 am to 4:00 pm, grades K to 6 (grade entering in fall 2026), $245 a week non member ($235 member), nine themed weeks June 22 to August 21, 2026. Ages 5 to 12 derived from grades K to 6. Before care 7:30 to 9:00 am and after care 4:00 to 6:00 pm listed at $25 a week on the full day page and $50 a week on the handbook page. Packed lunch; optional $12 a week lunch add on. Toddler camps (ages 3 to 4), half day specialty camps and a CIT program (ages 13 to 15) are also in the catalog.
